status: PROPOSAL ONLY; not imported or applied to application
safeguards: Reuse existing semantic --ui-* family and maintain legacy aliases during migration.
Keep table rows, input interiors, PDF/print surfaces and contrast-critical content opaque.
Use glass on a limited number of card/modal surfaces with an opaque @supports fallback.
Do not blur table rows/cells, maps, all ancestor containers or animated scrolling content.
Do not overwrite saved branding, --portal-main-header-* slots, logo source/dimensions/objectFit or current main-header arrangement.
Apply module styling explicitly; do not turn every legacy page on by replacing global CSS.
Respect reduced motion, nested popovers and portal stacking.
Token additions such as --ui-card-opaque are proposed compatibility extensions, not a second theme system.
